title: Alex Eala suffers shock loss to qualifier Shi Han at Wuhan Open

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–Alex Eala’s return on Tour didn’t last long after she was stunned by Chinese qualifier Shi Han, 6-4, 3-6, 3-6, in the Wuhan Open first round on Monday night at Dongfeng-Voyah Center Court. Eala was halfway to advancing to the round of 32 of the final WTA 1000 event of the season, up 3-2 against Shi in the second set. But the Filipino sensation had trouble finding a good first serve and shot herself in the foot with an error-prone performance against a gritty opponent in the 217th-ranked Shi.
